Three gaps remain.

moments.why: before: the kite is at the flyer's hand on the hill; peak: it has climbed the whole page on its string to beside the wordmark; after: it holds there. The kite crosses most of the phone screen

before: a plain page with the ribbon ahead; peak: a yellow swipe the full width with 'first ribbon!' across it, rays around the kite and the count circled in red, about a third of the phone screen changes; but the after frame is already the results page
before: the kite nose-down with a red burst and 'thud!'; peak and after: the whole page has turned to night paper with the flight drawn as one line above the log

matches.claim: the phone title has the chosen frame's composition: the tilted wordmark on the left, the highlighter under Line, the kite on its string up the right edge from the flyer on the hatched hill

gaps.gap: 1.7 s after the first catch the after frame is already the results page: with nothing held the kite hits the ground before the celebration has finished, so the moment has no aftermath
gaps.fix: let the kite float longer after the first ribbon (full weight returning over about 3 s, not 1.5) so the banner finishes, the bow is seen on the tail and the count stands at 1 before the ground can come up

gaps.gap: on the phone the 'first ribbon!' lettering reaches the right edge of the screen and the exclamation mark touches it
gaps.fix: size the lettering to at most 80 % of the screen width so it sits inside the swipe with air on both sides

gaps.gap: the 'hold to climb' tape stays on screen over the pause sheet, in the place where the maker's line is meant to sit, and the credit is not visible
gaps.fix: hide the hint while paused so the maker's line reads at the bottom of the pause page
